# Read input values
size = int(input())
limit = int(input())
data = [int(input()) for _ in range(size)]

countSegments = 0
startIdx = 0
evenCount = 0
oddCount = 0
segmentDifferences = []

for i in range(size):
    if data[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    if evenCount == oddCount and i != size - 1:
        diff = abs(data[i + 1] - data[startIdx])
        segmentDifferences.append(diff)
        startIdx = i + 1
        evenCount = 0
        oddCount = 0

if len(segmentDifferences) > 0:
    segmentDifferences.sort()
    totalDiff = 0
    for i, diff in enumerate(segmentDifferences):
        totalDiff += diff
        if totalDiff > limit:
            countSegments = i
            break
        else:
            countSegments = i + 1
else:
    if size > 0:
        diff = abs(data[0] - data[0])
        if diff >= limit:
            countSegments = 1

print(countSegments)
